scientific_integrity: Classical strict negative-type and uniform-sphere energy theorems are credited, finite computations are not presented as infinite proof, and independent verification has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Requires unsquared Euclidean chord metric, a centered sphere, at least three distinct rim sites and center inside convex hull; does not control individual rim signs, non-Euclidean spaces, nor arbitrary interior added sites. Sharp endpoints are not attained. Priority is provisional.
title: A sharp dimension-dependent negative center-mass law for finite spherical metric spaces
